allow: Bash(cd menu_management && dart run build_runner build *)

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *.freezed.dart|*.g.dart) echo '[hook] WARNING: this is a GENERATED file. Revert the edit and change its source model instead, then run: cd menu_management && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs' ;; esac
FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$FILE" in *.freezed.dart|*.g.dart) ;; *.dart) cd menu_management && dart format --line-length 150 "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
